claims.claimText: The UC Davis School of Medicine policy says medical students may not use generative AI to directly author submitted assignments or generate answers for closed-book assessments unless faculty or course leadership gives written permission.
claims.claimValue: School of Medicine GenAI coursework use requires faculty or course leadership permission for direct authorship or closed-book assessment answers.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: GenAI may not be used to directly author any portion of a submitted assignment unless faculty or course leadership grants written permission.

claims.claimText: The UC Davis School of Medicine policy says medical students are not permitted to use external generative AI tools for patient care documentation except as allowed under UC Davis Health policy, and PHI must not be entered into a generative AI tool outside a secure institutionally supported system.
claims.claimValue: School of Medicine bars external GenAI patient-care documentation uses except under UC Davis Health policy and bars PHI outside secure supported systems.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: Under no circumstances should PHI be entered into any generative AI tool outside of a secure, institutionally supported system.
